Muramasa"...Mido. He meant to make you kill him, then make you kill me."
Muramasa"Using our vow of balancing good and evil."
Kageaki"Apparently."
Muramasa"...I would have accepted that..."
Muramasa"Thought that without me, you could forget fighting and live."
Kageaki"..."
Muramasa"Will you truly fight?"
Muramasa"Keep fighting?"
Muramasa"Is that truly what you want?"
Kageaki"Yes."

en.html:
Kageaki"I shall... rule all martial force in this world."
Kageaki"Stand at its summit. Lend strength to anyone who asks."
Kageaki"Anyone wanting victory will seek my power. But I shall exact a price."
Kageaki"That person. Someone precious to them."
Kageaki"What they must protect. Goodness. Justice."
Kageaki"Take it in payment for killing their enemy."
Muramasa"..."
Kageaki"Good and evil balance one another. I shall spread this martial law throughout the world."
Kageaki"Until everyone knows and admits that this is the truth of conflict... and loathes it."
Kageaki"Until fighting vanishes from the earth."
Muramasa"...Mido..."
Kageaki"Muramasa. What will you do?"
Kageaki"Will you come with me?"
Muramasa"—"
Muramasa"I..."

A clear strength answered.
To our joined hands, I swore.

At the end—
Someday, when our purpose was achieved...
We would offer our own payment.
What was most precious.
Each other.

en.html: A gust passed. The fierce spirit mingled in it scorched my skin. I turned. A girl I knew well stood beneath the dusk, deep-blue tsurugi beside her. Upon the face turned toward me— Anger.◆ Grief.◆ And resolve.
en.text:
A gust passed.
The fierce spirit mingled in it scorched my skin. I turned.
A girl I knew well stood beneath the dusk, deep-blue tsurugi beside her.

Upon the face turned toward me—
Anger.◆
Grief.◆
And resolve.

ja.html: 風が一陣、流れた。 　そこに紛れる猛気が、肌を炙る。 　俺は振り返った。 　良く知る少女が立っている。 　濃藍の劒冑を従えて、夕闇の下。 　今、俺へ向ける顔にあるものは―― 　怒り。◆ 　嘆き。◆ 　そして決意。
ja.text:
風が一陣、流れた。

　そこに紛れる猛気が、肌を炙る。
　俺は振り返った。

　良く知る少女が立っている。
　濃藍の劒冑を従えて、夕闇の下。

　今、俺へ向ける顔にあるものは――

　怒り。◆
　嘆き。◆
　そして決意。

en.html: Without a word, I sensed the inevitable battle arriving. My mouth twisted bitterly—◆then I noticed. Wrong. Not this. This was not the countenance of a demon approaching battle. I was about to enter a conflict I myself desired. What reason for resentment? The expression should be this. This—
en.text:
Without a word, I sensed the inevitable battle arriving.
My mouth twisted bitterly—◆then I noticed.
Wrong. Not this.
This was not the countenance of a demon approaching battle.

I was about to enter a conflict I myself desired.
What reason for resentment?
The expression should be this.
This—

ja.html: 一語も交わさず、避けられぬ戦いの到来を感じ取り。 　俺の口が苦く歪んで――◆ふと、気付く。 　違う。 　こうでは、ないな。 　戦いに臨む悪鬼の貌かおは、こうではない。 　俺は今から、俺自身が求めた闘争へ身を投じるのだ。 　苦にがる理由が何処にあろうか。 　表情は、こうだ。 　こう――
ja.text:
一語も交わさず、避けられぬ戦いの到来を感じ取り。
　俺の口が苦く歪んで――◆ふと、気付く。

　違う。
　こうでは、ないな。

　戦いに臨む悪鬼の貌かおは、こうではない。

　俺は今から、俺自身が求めた闘争へ身を投じるのだ。
　苦にがる理由が何処にあろうか。

　表情は、こうだ。
　こう――

Made my flesh steel—
